$comment: Authoritative dimensional parameters for the rack. Single source of truth: every model and script reads from here. Changing a value here changes the whole design. See docs/10-inch-spec.md for provenance of each number.

rack_unit.$source: EIA-310, inherited by the 10-inch format. Not in dispute.
rack_unit.$pattern_note: Distance from the top hole of a U to the middle, then middle to bottom.
rack_unit.$span_note: Vertical centres of a 2-hole 1U part: 1st and 3rd hole of the U.
rack_unit.$panel_note: Deliberately 0.8 mm shorter than 44.45, split 0.4 top and bottom.

rack.$module_note: 7 * 6U = 42U exactly, so every module boundary lands on a U boundary. See ADR-0001.
rack.$depth_status: PROVISIONAL - see ADR-0003. Common values are 200 and 260.

width.$hole_centres_source: Project MINI RACK community reference; matches the 19-inch offsets applied at half width.
width.$clear_opening_note: Absolute maximum horizontal clearance between rails.
width.$design_envelope_note: What a device or tray should actually fit within, allowing tolerance.
width.$tolerance_note: Acceptable deviation on an assembled rack. Beyond this, commercial panels will not fit.

rail.$thickness_status: PROVISIONAL - set by the rail model, not yet validated.

print.$shrink_note: Fractional scale factor applied to XY to compensate for material shrink. 0.4% is a starting point for PETG; re-measure per material.

stability.$anchor_note: A ~1.9 m tall, ~260 mm footprint rack is a tip hazard. Anchor or ballast, not optional.
stability.$footprint_note: Base plate extends this far beyond the frame on each side.
stability.$load_note: Design target for a printed shelf. Validate with the Phase 1 load test.
